inlines.v: GAM'BOL, verb intransitive 1. To dance and skip about in sport; to frisk; to leap; to play in frolic, like boys and lambs. 2. To leap; to start. GAM'BOL, noun A skipping or leaping about in frolic; a skip; a hop; a leap; a sportive prank.
